sysctl -qw net.ipv4.conf.eth3.forwarding=1

    ip link set eth1 nomaster 2>/dev/null || true
    ip link set eth2 nomaster 2>/dev/null || true
    ip link del bond0 2>/dev/null || true
fi
ip link add bond0 type bond mode balance-rr miimon 100
ip link set eth1 down
ip link set eth1 master bond0
ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 down
ip link set eth2 master bond0
ip link set eth2 up
ip link set bond0 up

ip addr add 10.10.12.1/30 dev bond0

# Route to node4's private network via the bonded link to node2
